card.name: Large subsets of {1, ..., 1000} in which every sum has at most two representations (B2[2] sets)

task.name: Large subsets of {1, ..., 1000} in which every sum has at most two representations (B2[2] sets)
task.description: construct() -> distinct integers in 1..1000 such that every integer has at most two representations a + b with a <= b from the set (exact count). Maximize the size. Sizes for N = 1000 are finite lower bounds for the extremal function (the asymptotic constant is at least 3/2); no finite optimum is documented.
